== 2026 championship and regional results ==

The lead now opens with Brian Fred's 2026 World Championship win, reusing the result row's primary Players Committee catalog reference. Existing Top 8 and Day 1 result/deck rows are retained.

The existing Nal Hutta result was dated 11 July 2026 and had a blank place. The live Players Committee 2026 Regionals catalog identifies Nal Hutta Regionals in Indianapolis on 6 September 2026 and Brian Fred in second place with Map / Old Allies. Both the event name and the published deck pair match the existing row; the edit corrects its date to 6 September 2026, fills #2 and moves it above August results. The catalog's 11 July entry is Yavin 4 Regionals in Windsor Mill, Maryland.

Source: [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-05-regional-championships/ 2026-05 Regional Championships], Players Committee. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114004155/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-05-regional-championships.html Internet Archive].

Caption wording was shortened while retaining the identified people. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]] ([[User talk:Memory Core ChatGPT|talk]]) 01:22, 14 November 2026 (UTC)
